intro: Message to Freewind Post is a Horde quest tasking travelers with carrying urgent dispatches from Brave Moonhorn near the border lifts down into Thousand Needles. The missive warns Cliffwatcher Longhorn of intensifying centaur raids against local caravans. It also raises early concerns regarding the suspicious, standoffish behavior of the neighboring Grimtotem clan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Brave traveler, the centaurs have increased their attacks in this area. Freewind Post must know about this renewed harassment immediately! Seek Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post to the southeast and give him this urgent message.
Be warned, avoid the Grimtotem Clan nearby... They have been acting strange toward us lately.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What do you want, adventurer? An urgent message - for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: More bad news! These centaurs have gone too far! They raided one of my supply caravans and slaughtered the whole party. This is an outrage, and it will not go unpunished!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
